"Signing out deletes that phone\'s downloads after confirmation. You can close sessions or unlink devices in My account. Blocking or deleting an account revokes access and orders file deletion on the next contact; copies exported to other apps are outside Tubego\'s control."

"Downloaded files stay on your phone until you delete them. If space is low, the app pauses downloads and alerts you without automatically deleting content. Android may delay background work; if you force-stop Tubego, open the app to resume it."

"Cleanup and retention changes apply to the server. Blocking or deleting users revokes access and orders deletion of their local copies on the next contact. Every destructive action asks for confirmation on its screen. Administration is unavailable offline."

"An administrator approves accounts after email verification. Only administrators change user priorities, retention, limits, global cleanup and maintenance. Unless server retention is enabled, files are deleted when all devices confirm delivery or the limit expires: initially four hours after the first delivery and at most three days after the file is ready. Administrators can change these limits for all existing files."

"Server speed is measured in Administration; it does not download a large test to your phone. Diagnostics shows your connection and alerts; it does not share passwords, tokens or other accounts\' private logs. The Telegram bot still works with a separate list."
